name: Static Replayed
summary: You find a tape whilst digging through a box of supplies that came from a recent shipment that was issued regarding the destruction and extermination of these items. Intrigued, You load the tape into a VCR. 18th of October 2000, The Genesis Institute for Aesthetic Enhancement has just entered a severe lock down.
